title: Verify Technician can pick a part on a work order line
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Technician role. (this role has Pick Parts ON - the only parts action allowed).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
A part is available in inventory to pick. Note: an OVER LIMIT badge on the customer does not block picking parts.
steps:
1. Open a work order line and open the parts actions.
2. Click Pick, select the part and quantity, and confirm.
expected: The part is picked onto the line successfully.
